mapper.select: SELECT T.target_seq AS "targetSeq", T.form_template_seq AS "formTemplateSeq", T.target_role AS "targetRole", T.target_type AS "targetType", T.ref_seq AS "refSeq", T.create_user AS "createUser", T.create_at AS "createAt", T.update_user AS "updateUser", T.update_at AS "updateAt", T.del_yn AS "delYn", T.note, COALESCE(I.user_name_ko, D.dept_name) AS "refName", COALESCE(E.office_employee_dept, D.dept_name) AS "refDept", E.office_employee_position AS "refPosition", I.user_email AS "refEmail", I.user_mobile_no AS "refMobile" FROM utb_form_template_target T LEFT JOIN utb_user_info I ON T.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND (T.ref_seq = I.user_mst_seq OR T.ref_seq = I.user_info_seq) AND I.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_office_employee E ON T.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND (T.ref_seq = E.user_mst_seq OR T.ref_seq = E.office_employee_seq) AND E.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_dept_mst D ON T.target_type = 'DEPT' AND T.ref_seq = D.dept_seq AND D.del_yn = 'N' WHERE T.form_template_seq = #{formTemplateSeq} AND T.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_form_template_target')
INSERT INTO utb_form_template_target ( target_seq, form_template_seq, target_role, target_type, ref_seq, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{targetSeq}, #{formTemplateSeq}, #{targetRole}, #{targetType}, #{refSeq}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
